summary: Quiet residential kerb with houses 12 m away; steep hill.
reasons: Houses 12 m away on same side

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses sit about 12 m behind the kerb along the whole stretch, with more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Ordinary street kerb with room to park; a car already parks on the south side.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, light local traffic.
drivers.convention: Only a few cars park here; 2P signs Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted, so overnight is outside the limit.

flags: Homes within about 12 m on own side
sun_shade: Street trees and house gardens give patchy shade; open sun from the south.

best_section.where: Montrose Road north kerb, opposite the grassy lot's east end
